authorization: User explicitly approved switching from identification to selecting/freezing a candidate and concurrent paired hardware comparison against ordinary BLNN. User manually flashes and records. No assistant hardware operation.
stage: Prospectively fixed paired replication of an existing exploratory candidate. Not a newly designed controller, not proof of mechanism novelty or completed paper evidence.
candidate: Original S3R2, build66312, NOT R8, a system-identification build or an unqualified newer host-only branch.
selectionRationale: Traceable original implementation, completed physical runs and retained safety/timing evidence. Selected as the established implementation base, not as a claim that its historical best run will reproduce. Later concurrent runs also showed worse tracking and synchronization; retain those negative observations. This new comparison is allowed to refute the candidate.

design.orderMeaning: Prospectively alternating order, 3vs2 first-method counts because five blocks is odd. Not fully randomized and not guaranteed to remove nonlinear drift.
design.firstReview: After pair01 check identity, safe completion and data quality only. Do not tune parameters, switch candidates or stop on an unfavorable performance result. Later pairs retain this exact protocol.
design.conditionsWithinPair: Same load, secured mechanics, origin procedure, consistent rest/preparation and fresh controller initialization. Record battery voltage and temperature. Do not charge, repair or change hardware midway through a block; if required, mark interruption and pause review rather than silently treating it as matched.
design.operationalRest: After successful stop and export completion retain drive off for at least60seconds before the next run; same minimum for both methods. This standardizes a minimum rest, not proof of equal motor temperature.
design.parameterFreeze: No gain, allocator, learning, leakage, node-growth, limit, reference or guard edits during the series. Existing method differences are intentional whole-controller differences, including CA NN envelope versus ordinary output path. No equalized-envelope or isolated-module claim.
design.historicalData: All prior R2/ordinary/Q0/T1 records remain exploratory/context and are excluded from this prospective paired summary.
design.failurePolicy: Keep every attempt including faults, incomplete exports and negative outcomes. A fault or abnormal motion pauses the block for review. No automatic replacement, favorable-only selection or extension beyond ten planned runs. Any retry requires a logged reason and distinct attempt suffix. An incomplete event export alone does not invalidate an otherwise complete primary motion record.

manualOperation.firmware: Open the frozen copy, select the named target and download the existing verified AXF without rebuilding. If Keil requires rebuild or image hashes differ, stop for review. CMSIS-DAP options already exist. Do not flash an identification build.
manualOperation.safety: Drive power off while flashing. Unloaded secured platform, clear travel, onsite operator and emergency stop. No unattended operation. Original guards stay intact; zero command is not a mechanical holding brake.
manualOperation.start: These archived executables auto-arm once after about8seconds of healthy stationary operation. Enable VOFA reception and clear old history before a deliberate fresh control-board power-on/reset. Each run must start from fresh weights. No reset, reflash or concatenated reboot within one CSV. Do not rush drive-power switching to beat the auto-arm delay; if preparation was missed, safely stop and review the capture rather than improvising.
manualOperation.successExport: All107 channels. Require phase6, fault0, I88 method-specific4422/4424 and I89=4. Keep receiving at least10seconds after status4 AND until I0>=100seconds. The100seconds alone is not completion. Export before clearing history. These are archived EVENT40/EVENT48 markers, not Q0/T1 markers.
manualOperation.abnormal: If phase9, I22nonzero, vibration, jam or unusual sound: stop safely and preserve the same history, including fault replay and at least5seconds tail if safe. Do not reset or silently rerun.

analysis.primary: Per-run left-right synchronization RMS_mm, then within-block S3R2-minus-BLNN differences. Negative means lower sync error.
analysis.primaryWindow: Own native40ms telemetry rows with phase2..5 AND drivePermit(I106)=1, nominal elapsed4..20seconds. Use the same phase rule for both methods, not data-dependent windows or chosen favorable segments.
analysis.gridPolicy: No interpolation, zero fill or forced exact timestamp intersection. Compute each method on its own complete native grid; report sample count, observed time span and grid offset. Expect399..401samples, span>=15.90seconds, all phases2..5, no sequence loss across active motion. Deviations require review and may not be silently repaired.
analysis.recordQuality: One run per CSV, correct I21/I63 identity, same configured load/limits/HW6, complete phase progression, fault0 and no active-motion sequence gaps. Check overrun/late, UART/DMA/CAN counters and feedback freshness. Keep failed records in the outcome ledger; do not equate rejection with missing evidence.
secondary: mean-position tracking RMSE and maximum absolute error
command and constraint activity, learning and nodes
voltage/temperature, faults, timing and communication quality
analysis.eventEvidence: Event windows differ at5s and18s, so never compare them as matched mechanism samples. Decode each mapping separately and check all128records with duplicate agreement. Event completeness is separate from motion-metric completeness.
analysis.reporting: Show all run outcomes, every paired difference, per-method mean/SD and paired-difference mean/SD/range. Five blocks are a starting evidence size, not a guarantee of significance, innovation or superiority.
analysis.interpretation: Research objective is sync benefit with tracking cost reported, not universal metric dominance. No task-based tracking tolerance has been supplied, so do not claim tracking meets application requirements. If both errors worsen or benefits are inconsistent, report that outcome; do not retune inside this series.
analysis.mechanismBoundary: Two-method whole-controller comparison cannot independently attribute gains to classifier, repair or retention. Additional isolated evidence is required before claiming those components separately effective.
